options.name: --allow-requantize
options.description: Allow requantizing tensors that have already been quantized WARNING: this can severely reduce quality compared to quantizing from 16bit or 32bit!

options.name: --leave-output-tensor
options.description: Leave output.weight un(re)quantized increases model size but may also increase quality, especially when requantizing

options.name: --pure
options.description: Disable k-quant mixtures and quantize all tensors to the same type

options.name: --imatrix
options.description: Use data in file_name as importance matrix for quant optimizations

options.name: --include-weights
options.description: Use importance matrix for this/these tensor(s)

options.name: --exclude-weights
options.description: Do not use importance matrix for this/these tensor(s)

options.name: --output-tensor-type
options.description: Use this ggml_type for the output.weight tensor

options.name: --token-embedding-type
options.description: Use this ggml_type for the token embeddings tensor

options.name: --tensor-type
options.description: Quantize this tensor to this ggml_type this is an advanced option to selectively quantize tensors. may be specified multiple times. example: --tensor-type attn_q=q8_0

options.name: --tensor-type-file
options.description: List of tensors to quantize to a specific ggml_type this is an advanced option to selectively quantize a long list of tensors. the file should use the same format as above, separated by spaces or newlines

options.name: --prune-layers
options.description: Comma-separated list of layer numbers to prune from the model WARNING: this is an advanced option, use with care

options.name: --keep-split
options.description: Generate quantized model in the same shards as input

options.name: --override-kv
options.description: Override model metadata by key in the quantized model. may be specified multiple times. WARNING: this is an advanced option, use with care

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Calculate and show the final quantization size without performing quantization example: llama-quantize --dry-run model-f32.gguf Q4_K

options.name: --max-buffer-size
options.description: Max amount of tensor rows kept in memory while quantizing one tensor (default: 8192) lower it to quantize models with very large tensors on a machine with little RAM
